item.title: Jobs people do
item.description: Common jobs and the people you meet at work every day.

children.definition: a person whose job is to help students learn
children.example: My aunt is an English teacher at a school in Namangan.

children.definition: a person whose job is to help ill people get better
children.example: The doctor says I need to rest.

children.definition: a person who looks after ill people in a hospital
children.example: The nurse gave me some water.

children.definition: a person whose job is to drive a bus, taxi or car
children.example: The taxi driver knows every street in Tashkent.

children.definition: a person who grows fruit and vegetables or keeps animals
children.example: My grandfather is a farmer. He grows melons.

children.definition: a person who helps customers in a shop
children.example: The shop assistant found the right size for me.

children.definition: a person whose job is to keep people safe and stop crime
children.example: A police officer helped the old man cross the road.

children.definition: a person who designs and builds machines, roads or computer systems
children.example: He works as an engineer at a factory.

children.definition: a person whose job is to make houses and other buildings
children.example: The builders are working on a new school near our house.

children.definition: a person whose job is to cut and style hair
children.example: I go to the hairdresser once a month.

children.definition: a person who flies a plane
special clothes that people wear for their job or school
children.example: Nurses at this hospital wear a blue uniform.
